footnotePayLater: Refer to your loan agreement for lender info and details. All loans are subject to credit approval. Service fees range from $0–$7.49 based on purchase price & merchant. Subscribers pay no service fees (0% APR); subscription fees are billed separately & excluded from the APR.

footnoteSezzleUp: Opt-in to voluntary credit reporting by enrolling in Sezzle Up. Increases or specific changes to your credit score are not guaranteed. Impact on your credit score may vary depending on your use. All payments, including late payments, are required to be reported, which may negatively impact your credit score. Credit scores are independently determined by credit bureaus based on a number of factors, including the financial decisions you make with other financial services organizations. The program and related services will not remove negative credit history from your credit report.

faq1Q: Does using Sezzle affect my credit score?
faq1A: No. Applying never runs a hard credit check, so it won't impact your score. You can also opt in to Sezzle Up,{sezzleUp} our free credit-building program.
faq2A: Your first payment is due at checkout. The remaining payments are charged automatically every 2 weeks - over 6 weeks for Pay in 4{faq2APi5}.{payLater}
faq3A: Yes. Open the Sezzle app, navigate to the 'Orders' tab, find your order, and move an upcoming payment date to better fit your budget.
